# Asset slots (v1 budget)

Only these images may be generated. Add a row before creating any new graphic.

| Slot ID | Page / use | Role | Aspect | Target px | Path | Safe crop / text overlay | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hero-home` | Home hero | Full-bleed atmosphere | 16:9 | 2400×1350 | `apps/web/public/assets/hero-home.webp` | Keep subject right/center; left third quieter for headline | todo |
| `pray-atmosphere` | Pray section | Section visual | 4:3 | 1600×1200 | `apps/web/public/assets/pray-atmosphere.webp` | Soft focus; no faces required | todo |
| `support-atmosphere` | Give / support | Section visual | 4:3 | 1600×1200 | `apps/web/public/assets/support-atmosphere.webp` | Calm, non-guilt imagery | todo |
| `og-default` | Social share | Open Graph | 1.91:1 | 1200×630 | `apps/web/public/assets/og-default.jpg` | Centered subject; title added by OG template in code if needed | todo |
| `app-icon` | PWA / directories | Icon | 1:1 | 1024×1024 | `apps/web/public/assets/app-icon.png` | Simple mark-friendly; may be logo-derived, not a photo | todo |

## Rules

- v1 aim: **≤5–6 images** total  
- No decorative extras “for polish”  
- Icons in UI = one code icon set — not generated art — unless listed above  
- Status values: `todo` | `in_progress` | `done` | `rejected`
